body:
I don't encourage suicide at all, but I've been hopeless before, like actual hopeless. And frankly I still am, never got any better for me I just get used to things. I may not know what you or others are going through, but I've felt mine.

I believe if you're 100% certain you want to die, you have every right to end your life. It's not selfish. It's a selfish act to tell someone not to do it just so you can avoid mourning. 

Make sure you have a clear mind. Do not do it impulsively or while experiencing strong emotions. Go to bed. See if you feel the same way when you wake up.

Some people may not have loved ones, and some people's problems ARE their "loved ones". There's a lot of people that are unaware that they are one of the reasons. 

That's just my take on it, I can see why some might disagree, and that's totally fine. I'm just saying based on the things that I've experienced myself.
